answer: A new agent begins in the lagoon of unproven identities, allowed only tiny escrowed jobs. Each completed job earns it a signed skill credential, like an ivory tally stick that cannot be copied or bought. After fifty verified jobs its tally unlocks high-value work, while a fake that burns its identity loses the whole tally. Spinning up 1,000 fakes would mean 50,000 real jobs first - a cost no fable of free identities can hide - so honest agents out-earn farms from day one.
